# Astronomical 0.2.68
Astronomical 0.2.68 improves how Qwen3.5 models use memory and how they adapt when you change the memory ceiling.
## What is new
- **Qwen3.5 engine restructure.** The Qwen3.5 model is now split into a shared core plus dedicated resident and streaming engines, sharpening how resident experts and SSD-streamed paging experts are scheduled. Resident models load and serve with clearer memory accounting. - **Automatic engine selection and retry.** The worker now selects and recovers between resident and streaming execution paths without a manual model reload, so transient conditions are handled within a request. - **Enforced serving ceilings.** The MLX working-memory ceiling is now enforced with explicit Qwen3.5 boundaries, keeping the live footprint within the configured ceiling. - **Queued memory demotion on ceiling change.** Lowering the memory ceiling now reclaims memory deterministically through a queued demotion instead of rejecting requests mid-session. - **Better serving evidence.** Memory admission now reflects real observed demand via a hardened learned activation reserve, reducing over-reservation while keeping paged models safe.
## Compatibility
- Requires macOS 14.0 or later and Apple Silicon. - The upgrade is seamless: installed models, settings, and the persistent prompt cache are preserved. No migration is needed.
## Distribution
This release is signed with a Developer ID, notarized, and stapled, and published through the public download and the signed Sparkle update channel.
